title: How Chinese Carbon Road Bikes Are Taking Over - Alvas DA54 vs Canyon Aeroad CFR

takeaways.text: As built (Shimano 105, Helux carbon crank, 50 mm carbon-spoked wheels, Magene pedals) the DA54 cost ¥28,000 and weighed 7.7 kg, against 7.3 kg for the presenter's Canyon Aeroad CFR at about £10,000–11,000.
He describes the DA54 geometry as very similar to the Aeroad, although his DA54 front end was set 3 cm lower.
In uncontrolled windy road loops the speeds at 200 W and 250 W were practically the same; he attributes differences mainly to rider position and wheels rather than the frame.

disclosure: The channel says it has worked with ALVAS for over half a year and visited its factories; the description links ALVAS.
summary: An informal powered loop test of China Rides' ALVAS DA54 (105 Di2, Helux carbon wheels) against a Canyon Aeroad CFR at 200 and 250 W.
